cards.title: Monthly SEO Keyword Evaluation Cycle
cards.summary: Run a recurring monthly review of your target keywords to confirm they are still worth ranking for, and swap them out when they are not.
cards.use_when: Planning the SEO work cadence for your store, or setting up a standing process to decide which categories, collections or blog topics to optimize next.
steps: Review whether selected keywords still match the store's products and buyer intent.
Keep relevant targets; replace targets that no longer fit the business.
Research, write and publish useful product-related content at a sustainable cadence, then repeat the review.
caveats: Monthly is the source's suggested cadence, not a ranking rule; more frequent publishing is not inherently better.
